description: Window live resize (resize-frames-live.py): the bottom-right corner dragged one debug.mouse event per 120 Hz frame, out by 300 x 150 points and back twice, over the sidebar, a terminal and a New Tab page (a web view) side by side; display-frame intervals, main-thread busy ms per frame, each drag event's round trip, missed vsyncs and the rounds that did not resize, light session.
